title: Track stock and refuse orders we cannot fill
description: Products get an optional stock count; products without one, such as e-books, are not tracked. Placing an order takes the items out of stock, and an order larger than the stock is refused with 409. Includes the migration, tests and a README note.

comments.issue: Stock is read, checked and written back as `product.stock - quantity` inside a transaction at Postgres's default READ COMMITTED level, which does not lock the row, so two concurrent orders can both pass the check and both write their own result: stock is oversold and one decrement is lost. Use a conditional atomic update (`updateMany` where `stock >= quantity` with `decrement`) or lock the row.
